summary: Integrate a correct kernel into a framework while respecting layouts, streams, allocation, gradients and compiler contracts.
outcomes: Register an operator with explicit shape, dtype and device behavior.
Validate autograd and framework integration separately from forward numerics.
sequence: Define the operator’s mathematical and API contract.
Connect tensors to the correct stream and allocation lifetime.
Register schema and supported dispatch behavior.
Add fake/meta behavior and gradients where needed.
Test noncontiguous tensors, compilation, errors and reference gradients.

visual.question: Which assumptions must remain true at the framework boundary?
visual.interaction: Trace a tensor and gradient through dispatch, kernel and backward.

practice.task: Package a small custom operation with reference and gradient checks.
practice.success: Shape/device errors are clear; forward, backward and supported compiled execution pass independently.
